title: Traveling with carnival shows
summary: He toured with carnival shows as a drummer.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: We don't have to fill up the rest of this tape if you can't think of anything else to tell us. I enjoy talking about it. Anything else about your life or any drumming or anything else you'd like to add before we quit?
The only thing, I went off with a few bands, played a lot of carnivals.
I wonder if you ever traveled with the ten shows and things like that.

Yeah. I went off with a world of moight, a cavalcade of amusement, stayed out there a lot of wonderful time out there with musicians that I didn't knew. When I got there, they had musicians there already but they needed a drummer.
